name: sec_stripe
layout: A yellow (#f6c90e) and dark charcoal diagonal hazard-stripe border around the whole image. Inside, a white card with a thick orange (#d2562a) border and rounded corners: the title in navy bold with a yellow marker highlight, the lines in navy with '前日までに一言' in orange and bigger, and at the bottom a Japanese woman in a black business suit bowing politely, in front view.
